samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    line1 = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    n = int(line1)
    
    total = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
        total += int(line)
    
    print(total // n)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
